research_rationale:
Executive Order 13848 (83 FR 46843, signed 2018-09-12, published 2018-09-14, FR Doc. 2018-20203) was read in full from the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13848.txt, the registered official original. Number, date, title and signature date match the register. The 54-clause inventory (the opening clause, section 1(a) through (f) with paragraphs (b)(i) and (b)(ii), section 2 with paragraphs (a)(i) through (iii), (b) and (c), section 3 with paragraphs (a) and (b) and the nine listed sanctions, sections 4 through 13, and section 14 with its paragraphs) covers the whole text. The order is emergency-dependent: it declares the national emergency in its opening words, and the President continued the emergency by notice each year from 2019 through 2026 (eight held notices, recorded as later events on the opening clause and on section 2; the last, signed August 31, 2026, continues it beyond September 12, 2026, so the emergency was in force on 2026-10-14). No held instrument revokes, supersedes or amends the order. The recurring election duties in sections 1 and 3 are not ended by the passing of any election cycle. The only one-time command, the 30-day framework in section 1(f), is a deadline and not an end, and no held source shows its performance. Executive Order 13757 and later orders that amend Executive Order 13694 are not acts on this order; section 2(b) merely states that Executive Order 13694, as amended by Executive Order 13757, remains in effect. The held corpus of executive-order texts runs through Executive Order 14435 (signed 2026-10-05); orders signed from October 6 through October 14, 2026 are covered only by the catalog search.
